## About Vue Piccadilly Circus

Vue Piccadilly Circus is a **Trusted Tagvenue Partner**, validated by the Tagvenue team with a record of successful bookings on the platform.

Top-notch audio-visual technology, catering and satellite capabilities, Vue ticks all the boxes when it comes to picking a venue for business meetings and events. Think conferences, awards ceremonies, AGMs, presentations, seminars, training days, product launches, and of course, film parties and private screenings.

Located on Lower Regent Street near Haymarket in Central London, Vue Piccadilly has 5 screens with 481 seats. The venue benefits from a bar space in the main public foyer which can be allocated to your group for standing receptions of up to 70 delegates.

Vue Piccadilly is easily accessible via public transport, with Piccadilly Circus as its closest station and Leicester Square and Charing Cross stations nearby.
